worlds.rule: Each world has its own city, resources, research and alliance. Your account, inventory, prestige and equipped relics are shared across all worlds.
building.description.watch_tower: A lookout over your city. This is your gateway to the world map.
building.description.castle: The heart of your kingdom. A larger castle allows higher building levels.
building.description.farm: Supplies your troops with food. Production continues while you are offline.
building.description.lumber_camp: Provides lumber for new buildings and training your army.
building.description.quarry: Stone turns a small village into a sturdy fortress.
building.description.gold_mine: Gold funds your research and valuable improvements.
building.description.barrack: Trains steadfast infantry for the front line.
building.description.archery_range: Your archers practice precision and ranged combat here.
building.description.stable: Riders and their loyal horses train here for the next mission.
building.description.academy: Knowledge is power. Research lasting improvements for your kingdom.
building.description.wall: Protects your city and is required for the next castle upgrade.
building.description.storage: Increases storage space for your produced resources.
building.description.treasure_house: Keeps the treasures of your kingdom safe.
building.description.trading_post: A meeting place for merchants and travelers.
building.description.hall_of_alliance: A place for shared plans and allies.
landing.hero_text: Build a living city, forge mighty armies and join forces with other rulers. Every decision shapes your shared world.
landing.real_alpha: Not a render. This is the alpha.
landing.rhythm: You do not jump between interchangeable menus. City, world and battle share one rhythm: prepare, decide and act together.
landing.city_awakes_text: Collect income, check building sites and coordinate research with training.
landing.world_calls_text: Secure resources, read the open paths and discover where your alliance needs you.
landing.march_begins_text: Choose troops, weigh the travel time and attack only when the commitment is right.
landing.real_footage: All footage comes from the current game build, with the real HUD, actual buildings and the current world map.
landing.world_caption: Read the map. Choose your path.
landing.plan_text: Your castle level alone does not decide a war. March times, supplies, specializations, defense and the right moment matter just as much.
landing.research_army_text: – develop clear strengths instead of starting everything at once.
landing.world_alliances_text: – share information, support allies and choose your battles.
landing.oath_text: Conquer does not reward a lonely checklist. Your kingdom develops its own character through priorities, allies and the battles you deliberately fight or avoid.
landing.alpha_text: The alpha is a real playtest: systems are expanded, values adjusted and bugs fixed. Your feedback influences what Conquer becomes.
landing.you_bring_text: A valid alpha key, a modern browser and an interest in honest feedback.
landing.expect_text: Unfinished content, balance changes, possible interruptions and, where technically necessary, progress resets.
landing.promise_text: No pay-to-win test, transparent changes and a game that grows together with its testers.
landing.access_text: Redeem your personal access once when creating your account. After that, your player name and password are enough to continue.
landing.key_once: Your key is checked securely and is not stored in plain text.
landing.choose_credentials: Choose a name and password for your game account.
landing.progress_saved: Your progress is automatically saved on the server.
landing.new_or_member: New here or already part of the alpha?
landing.faq_alpha_answer: Access is limited to invited testers. The game is already playable, but it is still actively expanded and balanced.
landing.faq_key: Do I need the alpha key every time I log in?
landing.faq_key_answer: No. You redeem it once when creating your account. After that, sign in with your player name and password.
landing.faq_download: Do I need to download anything?
landing.faq_download_answer: No. Conquer runs directly in a modern browser and supports touch, portrait and landscape layouts.
landing.faq_offline: Does the world continue while I am offline?
landing.faq_offline_answer: Yes. Construction jobs, research and the shared world follow server time. You do not need to stay online.
landing.faq_reset_answer: During an alpha, a reset may be necessary when fundamental systems or data structures change. Such steps will be announced transparently.
landing.footer_text: A hand-drawn fantasy strategy game in active development.
recovery.title: Recover account
recovery.note: Use the recovery code you created and saved in your account. It can only be used once.
